details: The U.S. economy saw a slower-than-expected increase of 57,000 jobs in June, with the unemployment rate decreasing to 4.2% due to a shrinking labor force. This cooling labor market has led financial markets to scale back predictions for a near-term interest rate hike from the Federal Reserve, a development generally viewed favorably by investors in risk assets, including cryptocurrencies.
title: US Job Growth Slows in June, Reducing Fed Rate Hike Expectations

details: The anticipated CLARITY Act, aimed at establishing a clear regulatory framework for digital assets in the United States, was not passed by its unofficial July 4th deadline. This delay, attributed to legislative hurdles and ongoing disagreements over issues like DeFi regulation and stablecoin oversight, prolongs uncertainty for the cryptocurrency market and could impact institutional adoption.
title: US CLARITY Act Misses July 4 Deadline, Prolonging Crypto Regulatory Uncertainty

details: Iran's military command has threatened a "forceful response" to ships using unapproved routes in the Strait of Hormuz, a critical global energy trade conduit. This warning, issued after reports of "positive progress" in indirect US-Iranian peace talks, casts new doubt over trade flows and highlights persistent geopolitical instability in the Middle East, which can fuel oil price volatility and global economic concerns.
title: Iran Threatens Ships in Strait of Hormuz Amid Heightened Tensions
